Guard tab: guard-wifi-pill='Wi‑Fi: open' with guard-trust-network visible → tap → toast 'Network trusted', pill becomes 'Trusted network', guard-forget-network visible → tap → back to 'Wi‑Fi: open'. Patrol tab: patrol-export-button visible; with 0 events → toast 'Nothing to export yet.'; with 1 OPEN_WIFI event → toast 'Print dialog opened' (no crash, no red screen). Patrol shows exactly one 'You're on an open Wi‑Fi network' event after OPEN_WIFI+home verify. /family screen renders 'Family responses to your alerts' card testID='family-acks' with empty text 'No responses yet. When someone you share with marks an alert handled, it shows here.'. No React Native red screens, no deprecated Expo packages introduced, no console errors of concern (only pointerEvents style deprecation warning already present).
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing flakiness: /app/backend/tests/test_family.py::TestSharedEvents::test_barking_event_shared fails under pytest-xdist LoadScope scheduling because TestSharedEvents can run in parallel with TestPairing (test-order dependency on DEV_B being linked). Not iteration-4 scope, but consider consolidating pairing setup into a class-scoped fixture or adding a small module-scoped 'ensure_linked' fixture so class-parallel scheduling stays green.

server.py ack endpoint (/api/family/shared-events/{event_id}/ack) does not check that a link still exists between guardian and protected before writing family_acks — today it writes as long as the shared_events row exists; if links have been deleted post-fanout, an ack still updates. Acceptable but worth documenting.

server.py ACK_LABEL only supports 4 labels — 'visiting' / 'noted' variants are unit-covered by validation (Literal Pydantic) but not exercised in tests; consider adding smoke tests if these UI paths are added later.

Frontend family.tsx exposes only 'I called them' / 'I messaged them' buttons in the Shared alerts card — the backend also accepts 'visiting' and 'noted'; PRD explicitly enumerates the 4 replies. If product intent is a 4-button set, UI is missing two. Currently PRD acceptance mentions only 'I called them' / 'I messaged them' so leaving as-is.

scripts/security-preflight.mjs dotenv parser is intentionally tiny and drops values containing '#' or '"' — fine today but a stray '#' in .env.production would silently be treated as a comment. Consider a stricter parser or reusing @expo/env in the future.
